sources.name: OpenStreetMap
sources.role: OSM-derived infrastructure vectors used as provider analytical evidence.
sources.distribution_guidance: Keep OpenStreetMap attribution with distributed provider output and follow ODbL obligations for any distributed database or derivative database.
availability_caveats: Overpass availability and query limits can vary.
OSM coverage and attribute completeness vary by area and asset type.
limitations: Passing validation does not prove complete real-world infrastructure coverage.

sources.name: Rybnik power seed nodes
sources.role: Local non-authoritative review input for the provider demo.
sources.attribution: Map Data Quality Lab manual seed input
sources.distribution_guidance: Keep the manual-seed label, non-authoritative flag and source reference when this input is displayed or exported.
availability_caveats: The seed file is local demo data and is not a public infrastructure registry.
limitations: Manual seed geometry must not replace OSM or authoritative utility data.

sources.name: Krajowa Integracja Uzbrojenia Terenu (KIUT/GESUT) WMS
sources.role: Remote visual reference overlay for comparing provider output with published WMS imagery.
sources.attribution: Źródło: Główny Urząd Geodezji i Kartografii (GUGiK), KIUT/GESUT WMS
sources.license: Verify current GUGiK service terms and metadata before redistributing rendered imagery or derivative output.
sources.distribution_guidance: Retain GUGiK/KIUT attribution when the overlay is shown. The current provider does not redistribute WMS imagery; any future redistribution requires a fresh terms and metadata review.
availability_caveats: Remote WMS availability, coverage and published layers can change.
The provider does not assume public WFS/vector access for this service.
limitations: WMS responses are rendered raster/reference imagery, not provider analytical vector geometry.
Do not convert WMS imagery to GeoJSON or use it as simulation input by default.
